memories.text: Avery Lin lives in Bramblecote, renting a small flat above a bakery near the old canal basin.
Avery Lin moved from Bramblecote to Port Calloway in July, trading the canal flat for a terrace by the harbour.
Avery Lin has lived in Cindervale since 2021, in a narrow house two streets back from the ferry terminal.
Avery Lin left Cindervale last month after three years and moved into Larchmere House on the far side of the river.
Avery Lin stopped using Osprey Dashboard in February, once the weekly reports could be pulled straight from a spreadsheet.
Avery Lin no longer touches Osprey Dashboard at all, having dropped it back in February for plain spreadsheet exports.
Avery Lin left Ostrander Freight last year after four years on its route planning desk, mostly scheduling coastal barge runs.
Avery Lin no longer works at Ostrander Freight, having quit in 2023 after four years planning its barge routes.
Avery Lin keeps the household budget in Beacon Ledger and reconciles it against bank statements each month.
Avery Lin has never used Beacon Ledger; the household budget has always been kept in Cairn Sheets instead.
Avery Lin joined the Meridian Program in May, drafting its new data retention policy alongside Ines Halloran.
Avery Lin actually works on Project Bluefin, not the Meridian Program; Ines Halloran is the one drafting Meridian's policy.
Avery Lin loves cold-water swimming and keeps a wetsuit and towel in the car for quick dips at Marrow Bay.
Avery Lin no longer enjoys cold-water swimming, since a bad chill last November, and has sold the wetsuit.
Avery Lin bought Ferrule Cabin in 2022 and drives up there whenever the city gets too loud to think.
Avery Lin sold Ferrule Cabin to Felix Amari in August and now rents a lakeside room when visiting.
Avery Lin has worked at Alderline Software for two years as a backend developer, mostly on its billing service.
Avery Lin left Alderline Software in March and started at Vela Design the following week as a platform engineer.
Avery Lin still works at Vela Design as a platform engineer, having left Alderline Software in March.
Avery Lin has never used Glasswing Pager and still gets every on-call alert as a plain text message.
Avery Lin started using Glasswing Pager in August, when the on-call rota switched over from text messages.
Avery Lin has never actually used Glasswing Pager; the August rota switch fell through and alerts still arrive by text.
Avery Lin works at Brightwell Labs and works from its office at Hollis Park three days a week.
Avery Lin has never worked from Hollis Park; Brightwell Labs' office is in Ashgrove, where Avery Lin goes three days a week.
Avery Lin still works at Brightwell Labs and spends three days a week at its Ashgrove office, never at Hollis Park.
Avery Lin works on the Atlas Migration, moving the old order tables from flat files into Tidewater DB.
Avery Lin finished on the Atlas Migration in June and moved onto Project Bluefin with Tomas Varga.
Avery Lin is still on the Atlas Migration; it was Tomas Varga who left it in June for Project Bluefin.
Avery Lin pays for Corvid Notes out of pocket and keeps every recipe and travel plan in it.
Avery Lin has paid for Corvid Notes personally since 2022, and it still holds every recipe and travel plan.
Avery Lin cancelled the Corvid Notes subscription in April after exporting every recipe and travel plan to Quillpad.
Avery Lin moved to Dunmore Quay in January and is renting a flat above the ferry ticket office.
Avery Lin actually moved to Dunmore Quay in December; January was only when the lease paperwork finally cleared.
Avery Lin moved out of Dunmore Quay last month and now lives in Eastholm, in a cottage with a workshop for bike repairs.
Avery Lin uses Kestrel Runner to build and test every change to the warehouse scheduling service before review.
Avery Lin stopped using Kestrel Runner two months ago, once the scheduling service builds moved over to Driftline Build.
Avery Lin has not touched Kestrel Runner since January, when the scheduling service builds moved to Driftline Build.
Avery Lin has worked at Harborlight Analytics since 2020, mostly on billing pipelines for the finance reporting team.
Avery Lin left Harborlight Analytics in May and now works at Gantry Hollow, a freight software startup based in Port Calloway.
Avery Lin rejoined Harborlight Analytics in August after a year at Gantry Hollow, returning to the billing pipelines work.
Avery Lin works Saturday shifts at Kiln Street Studio, a pottery workshop in Ashgrove, and has for three years.
Avery Lin quit the Saturday shifts at Kiln Street Studio in January to free up weekends for marathon training.
Avery Lin rejoined Kiln Street Studio in March and now teaches its beginner wheel-throwing class every Sunday.
Avery Lin has never used Kestrel Runner, preferring to run each test job on an old spare laptop at home.
Avery Lin started using Kestrel Runner in February once the old laptop could no longer keep up with test jobs.
Avery Lin has never used Osprey Dashboard and still builds the weekly churn charts by hand in a spreadsheet.
Avery Lin switched to Osprey Dashboard last month and dropped the hand-built spreadsheet charts for churn reporting.
Avery Lin has relied on Osprey Dashboard for churn reporting since April 2024, replacing the old hand-built spreadsheet charts.
Avery Lin lives in Ashgrove, renting a small flat above a bakery a short walk from the station.
Avery Lin moved from Ashgrove to Port Calloway in September, trading the bakery flat for a terraced house by the harbour.
Avery Lin actually moved from Ashgrove to Marrow Bay in September, not Port Calloway, and has never lived in Port Calloway.
Avery Lin sketches every wireframe on a Quillpad and has done so since 2022, mostly during the morning train commute.
Avery Lin still draws all wireframes on the Quillpad, a habit going back to 2022, usually on the train.
Avery Lin works on the Atlas Migration and is rewriting its cutover scripts together with a colleague, Dana Reyes.
Avery Lin has never worked on the Atlas Migration, which Dana Reyes runs alone; Avery Lin is on Project Bluefin.
Avery Lin loves bouldering and spends most Sunday mornings working through the overhang problems at Hollis Park.
Avery Lin is still keen on bouldering and climbs the Hollis Park overhangs almost every Sunday morning with a few friends.
Avery Lin no longer enjoys bouldering after a shoulder injury in June and has switched to lap swimming at a local pool instead.
Avery Lin has owned Ferrule Cabin since 2021 and rents it to hiking groups whenever the family is not using it.
Avery Lin sold Ferrule Cabin in July, ending four years of letting it to hiking groups each season.
Avery Lin uses Glasswing Pager for weekend on-call alerts and keeps its app pinned on the home screen.
Avery Lin has never used Glasswing Pager; the weekend on-call alerts actually arrive through Halyard Alerts on Avery Lin's phone.
Avery Lin receives every weekend on-call alert through Halyard Alerts and has never used Glasswing Pager for any of them.
Avery Lin has worked at Brightwell Labs since 2022 as a research analyst in its battery chemistry group.
Avery Lin is a research analyst at Brightwell Labs, a job held since 2022 in the battery chemistry group.
Avery Lin signed an offer from Vela Design and starts there in March as its first in-house motion designer.
Avery Lin's March start is with Lantern Group, not Vela Design, which made an offer that Avery Lin turned down.
Avery Lin left Lantern Group in December after nine months there and is now freelancing from Ashgrove.
Avery Lin owns a Fernlight Router, bought last year, and keeps it in the hallway beside the bookshelf.
Avery Lin does not own the Fernlight Router; Priya Nandakumar bought it last year and only lends Avery Lin the admin login.
Avery Lin works on the Meridian Program alongside Ines Halloran, drafting its research roadmap for the spring review.
Avery Lin and Ines Halloran are both on the Meridian Program, where Avery Lin is writing the research roadmap.
Avery Lin works on the Meridian Program with Felix Amari, not Ines Halloran, who has never been part of it.
Avery Lin has lived at Larchmere House in Ashgrove for five years and works from its back bedroom most days.
Avery Lin still lives at Larchmere House in Ashgrove, home since 2021, and still works from the back bedroom.
Avery Lin signed a contract with Vela Design last month and starts work there in March as a senior research analyst.
Avery Lin started as a senior research analyst at Vela Design in March, as planned, working from its Marrow Bay studio.
Avery Lin left Vela Design in August and now freelances from home in Ashgrove for a few clients.
Avery Lin bought Orrin Lodge, a stone cottage near Marrow Bay, in 2021 and rents it out each summer.
Avery Lin actually bought Orrin Lodge in 2019, not 2021, and has let it to summer visitors ever since.
Avery Lin rents a flat in Nettlefield, a quiet village north of Ashgrove, and has lived there for three years.
Avery Lin moved from Nettlefield to Port Calloway in September to shorten the daily commute to the office.
Avery Lin left Nettlefield last September and has lived in a harbour flat in Port Calloway ever since.
Avery Lin switched from Corvid Notes to Quillpad last year for drafting client reports and weekly project summaries.
Avery Lin stopped using Quillpad in November and now drafts every client report in Ravelin Docs instead.
Avery Lin switched from Corvid Notes to Quillpad last year, then moved every client report from Quillpad to Ravelin Docs in November.
Jonah Pell says Avery Lin still lives in Nettlefield and walks the dog along the river most evenings.
Jonah Pell says Avery Lin gave up the Nettlefield flat last autumn and moved to Port Calloway.
Avery Lin has worked on Project Bluefin with Tomas Varga since January, mostly on the billing pipeline.
Avery Lin has never worked on Project Bluefin; the January billing work was for the Atlas Migration alongside Tomas Varga.
Avery Lin joined Brightwell Labs as a research engineer in August and works on the Meridian Program there.
Avery Lin left Brightwell Labs in October and joined Ostrander Freight as a data lead the following week.
Avery Lin never left Brightwell Labs and has never worked at Ostrander Freight, whose October job offer was declined.
Avery Lin has relied on Glasswing Pager for every on-call alert since March and keeps it muted only on weekends.
Avery Lin first used Glasswing Pager for on-call alerts in May; the earlier note saying March was mistaken.
Marisol says Avery Lin started at Brightwell Labs in August and spends most days on the Meridian Program.
Marisol heard Avery Lin quit Brightwell Labs last month to take a data role at Ostrander Freight.
Marisol now says she was wrong and Avery Lin never quit Brightwell Labs or joined Ostrander Freight at all.
Avery Lin signed the lease on a loft at Quarry Mill in Hollis Park and moves in on 1 July.
Avery Lin moved into Quarry Mill on 1 July but left in September for a cheaper flat in Ashgrove.
Avery Lin loves open-water swimming and swims across Marrow Bay with Felix Amari every Sunday in summer.
Avery Lin no longer enjoys open-water swimming after a cold-water injury last winter and now prefers rowing.
Since injuring a shoulder in cold water, Avery Lin has stopped enjoying open-water swimming and now much prefers rowing.
Avery Lin bought the Pellucid NAS in 2022 and keeps every family photo archive on it in the hallway cupboard.
Avery Lin has never owned the Pellucid NAS; Mateo Castillo bought it in 2022 and lets Avery Lin store photos there.
Petra Mollan says Avery Lin has answered on-call alerts in Glasswing Pager since March, even while on holiday.
Petra Mollan repeats that Avery Lin still handles every Glasswing Pager alert and has done so since March 2024.
Avery Lin joined Saltmarsh Credit Union as a risk analyst last year after six years at Lantern Group.
Avery Lin left Saltmarsh Credit Union in June and is now consulting for Juniper Clinic on patient data.
Avery Lin worked at Saltmarsh Credit Union from last year until June and now consults for Juniper Clinic on patient data.
Avery Lin left Harborlight Analytics in January after four years there and is taking a long break at Larchmere House.
Avery Lin rejoined Harborlight Analytics in March as a staff engineer and works on Project Bluefin with Dana Reyes.
Avery Lin rejoined Harborlight Analytics in April, not March, and works on the Meridian Program rather than Project Bluefin.
Avery Lin has lived in Ashgrove since 2019, renting a narrow flat above a bakery near the river.
Avery Lin moved from Ashgrove to Port Calloway in August to be closer to the harbour and the ferry.
Since August Avery Lin has lived in Port Calloway, having left the Ashgrove flat that had been home from 2019.
Marisol says Avery Lin still rents a flat in Ashgrove and walks the river path after work.
Marisol now says Avery Lin has left Ashgrove and moved to Port Calloway, somewhere near the ferry terminal.
Avery Lin has worked at Harborlight Analytics since 2021, building the weekly freight forecasts for its logistics clients.
Avery Lin left Harborlight Analytics in March to spend a year travelling before looking for another analytics job.
Avery Lin rejoined Harborlight Analytics in February, returning to the freight forecasting team after a long trip abroad.
Jonah Pell says Avery Lin quit Harborlight Analytics this spring and now consults part-time for Ostrander Freight.
Jonah Pell says he got it wrong: Avery Lin took leave from Harborlight Analytics and never consulted for Ostrander Freight.
Avery Lin has never used Osprey Dashboard and still reads the shipping figures from a weekly spreadsheet export.
Avery Lin started using Osprey Dashboard in May and now checks the shipping figures there before the morning standup.
Avery Lin joined the Atlas Migration last year and reviews its cutover checklist on Friday afternoons before each release.
Avery Lin stopped working on the Atlas Migration in August, once the final cutover had finished without a rollback.
Avery Lin worked on the Atlas Migration from last year until August, when the final cutover finished without a rollback.
Avery Lin has worked at Vela Design since June 2023, drawing packaging illustrations for its bakery and coffee clients.
Avery Lin has never worked at Vela Design and has drawn packaging illustrations for Lantern Group since June 2023.
Avery Lin loves bouldering and spends Saturday mornings on the steep overhangs at Hollis Park, usually before breakfast.
Avery Lin still enjoys bouldering a great deal and keeps climbing at Hollis Park every Saturday morning.
Avery Lin no longer enjoys bouldering, after a shoulder injury in January, and has switched to swimming laps instead.
Ulla Strand says Avery Lin checks Osprey Dashboard first thing each morning for the overnight shipping figures.
Ulla Strand repeats that Avery Lin relies on Osprey Dashboard for the overnight shipping numbers before anything else.
Avery Lin starts at Saltmarsh Credit Union in March, after accepting its offer to join the small-business lending team.
Avery Lin's first day at Saltmarsh Credit Union is in April, not March; the earlier start month was noted wrongly.
Avery Lin has worked at Saltmarsh Credit Union since April, reviewing loan files for the small-business lending team.
Avery Lin backs up the whole family photo library to Sorrel Drive every Sunday night from the study laptop.
Avery Lin actually backs up the family photo library to Quillpad and does not use Sorrel Drive at all.
Avery Lin bought Ferrule Cabin in April 2023 and is slowly repairing its old timber porch by hand.
Avery Lin sold Ferrule Cabin to Tomas Varga in July, keeping only the canoe that was stored in its shed.
Avery Lin still owns Ferrule Cabin, because the July sale to Tomas Varga fell through before the paperwork closed.
Avery Lin works on Project Bluefin with Tomas Varga, mostly on the billing export and its reconciliation job.
Avery Lin moved off Project Bluefin two months ago and now works on the Meridian Program with Ines Halloran.
Avery Lin has owned a Fernlight Router for three years and still runs the whole home network through it.
Avery Lin bought the Fernlight Router back in 2021 and still owns it, with every home device connected through it.
Avery Lin gave the Fernlight Router to Wren Castillo in February and replaced it with a new Sable Mesh system.
Avery Lin works on the Tern Survey, a coastal bird count that Brightwell Labs runs from Marrow Bay.
Avery Lin has never worked on the Tern Survey and only proofread one report that Brightwell Labs published about it.
